title: Installment-Record Months in Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement Revisions
content:
**Questions and answers on the installment-record months of a revised Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement.**

**What is counted?** The patient-payment entries posted on the coverage account fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the handling date.

**How many months are added to the remaining term?**

| Entries in the window | Months added |
|---|---|
| at least 6 | 2 |
| at least 3 but fewer than 6 | 1 |
| fewer than 3 | 0 |

**Is an entry posted exactly 6 whole calendar months before the handling date counted?** No; it must be fewer than 6 whole months before.

**Example (hypothetical).** Six monthly payments, the earliest posted 5 whole months before the handling date: 6 entries, 2 months added. Four such payments: 1 month added.
